workflow.name: DeFi Pooled Value Conservation Hunt — Balanced v2.4
workflow.description: Focused hunt for permissionless pooled-value extraction in evidenced custody contracts, with invariant fan-out, hostile arithmetic verification, fork proof, program gate, and relative ranking. Import-valid v2.4: globally unique stage keys, a single dedup consume-all boundary, explicit proxy/storage/initialization coverage, and per-operation cross-contract neighborhoods for composition analysis. Balanced v2.4 restores one pre-verification coverage and root-cause consolidation barrier: every hypothesis branch completes before expensive verification, canonical candidates then fan out independently to final emission, and OpenKritt post-processing performs final finding deduplication and ranking.

steps.name: Freeze pooled-value program scope
Map evidenced pooled-value custody surfaces
steps.content:
Map only in-scope deployed contracts that custody or account for pooled user/protocol value between transactions, plus permissionless operations that change that value. Derive the contract set from current code and supplied deployment evidence; do not hard-code Pendle directories or assume prior router/custody conclusions remain true. Trace deposited assets, shares/tokens, reserves, internal totals, conversions, indexes, rounding, fees, oracle inputs, callbacks, and terminal transfers. Provide custody/TVL evidence and exact conservation/pricing invariants. Exclude atomic pass-through operations only when proven for this commit and deployment.

Use deterministic enumeration before reasoning: ripgrep plus language-aware AST/compiler tooling when available. Perform {{extra.repeat_runs}} independent enumeration passes when supplied (default: 2), compare their coverage, and record any coverage gap.

Web3 architecture expansion: identify whether the operation is reached through a transparent proxy, UUPS proxy, beacon, diamond/facet, minimal clone, metamorphic deployment, delegatecall-based module, or direct implementation. Trace proxy -> implementation/facet resolution, initializer state, upgrade authorization, storage slots/layout across relevant versions, selector routing, and every attacker-influenceable delegatecall target. Check deployed bytecode/configuration evidence rather than assuming source deployment.

For each operation, include its local cross-contract neighborhood: direct callers and callees, callbacks/hooks, shared storage/accounting dependencies, tokens/oracles/bridges it trusts, and related public operations that can prepare or consume its state. Follow at least two contract hops where source and deployment evidence permit. Populate the proxy/storage and cross-contract output fields even when the conclusion is "direct deployment / no relevant edge", with evidence.

steps.name: Pooled-value hypotheses A: round-trip conservation
steps.content: Fresh-context analysis of {{surface_operation_label}}. Hunt exact round-trip or conservation breaks that let an unprivileged actor receive more pooled value than supplied: mint/burn asymmetry, share inflation, first-depositor/donation, rounding accumulation, fee/index double count, reserve/internal-balance desync, or repeated boundary cycles. Require exact math and rounding direction, fund source, victim, sequence, realistic magnitude, locations, guards, and falsification target.

steps.name: Pooled-value hypotheses B: pricing and composition
Deduplicate pooled-value root causes
steps.content:
Cluster {{multi_output_depth_2}} by faulty value math/state operation, attacker primitive, victim/fund source, invariant, and fix. Preserve alternate profitable cycles and evidence conflicts. Create fingerprints; remove duplicates, unexplained balances, out-of-scope dependency assumptions, unproven deployment paths, and known accepted behavior.

Coverage rule: consolidate only after every hypothesis branch has completed. Emit every distinct code-grounded root cause that still warrants hostile verification. Triage priority is advisory metadata only; never discard a candidate solely because it is not labeled high priority.

steps.name: Independently verify and reproduce candidate
Apply program gate and emit progressive finding
